answer.summary: Converts a 6-digit date string (YYMMDD) into an 8-digit date string (YYYYMMDD) by determining the appropriate century prefix.
inputs: P#D6 (CHAR(6)): A 6-digit date string in YYMMDD format.
outputs: CHAR(8): The converted 8-digit date string in YYYYMMDD format.

rules.text: This routine is unused since the year 2000.
If the first two digits of the input date are greater than or equal to '94', prefix the date with '19'.
